deadline.value: The department accepts and reviews PhD applications on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: The Dept. of Computer Science accepts and reviews applications on a rolling basis.

fee_waiver.value: The department does not offer application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: We do not offer application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: The department has waived the GRE until further notice.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is waived until further notice.

gre_subject.value: The GRE is waived, and no CS subject test exists.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is waived until further notice.

toefl_min.value: The department asks for an internet-based TOEFL of at least 100 from international applicants.
toefl_min.quote: International students should submit TOEFL scores of at least 600 on the paper−based version, 250 on the computer−based version, and 100 on the internet−based version

ielts_min.value: The department asks for an IELTS score of at least 6.5 from international applicants.

supervisor.value: Students are not assigned a dissertation advisor; they identify one during the first years.
supervisor.quote: Students will not be automatically assigned a dissertation advisor.

funding.value: Applicants must secure an RA or TA position before they are offered admission.
funding.quote: Prospective students must secure competitive funding in the form of an RA or TA position BEFORE they are offered admission.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's or a master's can enter; a master's allows more transfer hours.
entry_route.quote: With an earned master's in computer science, up to 30 hours may be transferred. Otherwise, up to 12 hours may be transferred.

notes: No data science or AI PhD exists as a separate track in the CS PhD pages, so datasci is not saved.
name: Computer Science, Ph.D.
